recognize_zh: CD2 免疫染色下，只有少數小型圓核細胞呈強陽性（背景 T/NK 細胞），左下一顆大型、細胞質豐富的細胞呈細顆粒狀弱陽性，其餘卵圓至腎形核的腫瘤細胞大多陰性，符合肥大細胞白血病中 CD2 僅少數腫瘤細胞表現。
features: Scattered small lymphocytes with dense round nuclei show strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD2 staining
Rare large cell with abundant cytoplasm shows weak, fine granular cytoplasmic CD2 positivity
Majority of cells are medium to large with oval, indented or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm, negative for CD2
Loosely cohesive diffuse infiltrate; no specific architecture assessable at this magnification
Light hematoxylin counterstain; no significant nonspecific background staining
describe_en: CD2 immunohistochemistry on a biopsy involved by a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large cells with oval to reniform nuclei and pale cytoplasm. The majority of the infiltrating cells are negative, while rare large cells show weak granular cytoplasmic staining. Strong CD2 staining is seen in scattered small, round lymphocytes that represent background T/NK cells. Aberrant CD2 expression is limited to rare neoplastic cells; this finding supports, but in isolation does not establish, involvement by neoplastic mast cells, and correlation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 is required.

ddx.vs: In a reactive infiltrate the CD2-positive cells are small lymphocytes, whereas here the dominant large cell population is largely CD2 negative and requires tryptase/CD117 confirmation.
Monocytic blasts also have reniform nuclei but express CD14/CD163/lysozyme and lack tryptase and CD25 co-expression.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophil-rich background and are CD1a/langerin positive, tryptase negative.
